svg.title: Human direction and decisions guide an executing agent team
svg.desc: A top-down sled team travels upward. Explorer leads, followed by Architect and Reviewer, then Implementer and Tester. Towlines connect the five agent roles to the sled. A human musher on the sled provides direction and decisions; the AI agents provide execution. Fast and powerful, they need a musher.

g.text: Fast and powerful, but they need a musher.
